aiResearchSummary.text: D-ID is researching secure generation of avatars and three-dimensional human head reconstruction. In a system and method for enhancing the security of digital avatars, it verifies selfie videos using dynamic challenges and creates an identity log for controlled avatar enrollment. In a system and method for reconstruction of a three-dimensional human head model, it converts two dimensional facial images into detailed three dimensional face models. Together these efforts target secure avatar creation and high fidelity 3D face modeling.
